description: This file defines a spell checker API router for the Notesnook desktop application, including configuration, language management, and dictionary functions.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Query to check if the spell checker is enabled.

methods.name: languages
methods.description: Query to retrieve available spell checker languages with their names.

methods.name: enabledLanguages
methods.description: Query to retrieve currently enabled spell checker languages with their names.

methods.name: setLanguages
methods.description: Mutation to set the list of spell checker languages.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Mutation to enable or disable the spell checker.

methods.name: words
methods.description: Query to list words in the spell checker dictionary.

methods.name: deleteWord
methods.description: Mutation to remove a word from the spell checker dictionary.
